about: LocPC-CDE against its authors' code on the paper's random DAGs, with global PC read at the pair beside them; the release summary's LocPC-CDE entries are built from it
build: Andrey pre-release build of 14 November 2026 (the 0.18.0 release branch with the pair lane's PC arm counting its tests, as merged in this change)
hardware: AMD EPYC 7713 64-Core Processor, 1 core per fit, 1 BLAS thread; every arm of a dataset ran in one job on shared nodes, so the times are indicative
verdict_rule: per cell (20 datasets, seeds 0-19, one treatment-outcome pair each): per dataset D = Andrey's error minus the authors' code's on the same data; worse when the 95% percentile-bootstrap interval of the mean D lies wholly above 0 (10,000 resamples of the datasets, default_rng(0)), better when wholly below, a tie otherwise. A cell worse on seeds 0-19 on a measure was rerun on seeds 20-39 and is worse only when the fresh seeds agree. The floor, per dataset: the verdict error minus the constant 'not identifiable' answer's (1 on identifiable pairs, 0 on the others), the set's missing plus extra members minus the empty set's, and the effect error minus the unadjusted regression's; it applies where the authors' code's interval lies wholly below 0, and a row then passes when Andrey's does too
error_metric: verdict_error: 1 when the answer's identifiable is not the truth's (the true CPDAG directs every edge at the outcome, or not), an undecided or missing answer included, so that 1 minus its mean is the paper's identifiable proportion; parents_error (identifiable pairs): 1 unless the answer is identifiable with the outcome's true parents other than the treatment as its set; effect_error (linear-Gaussian identifiable pairs): the absolute error, in standard deviations, of the direct effect estimated by least squares of the outcome on the treatment and the set on a fresh sample, paired over the datasets where both arms gave a set
fit_protocol: each fit in a fresh process on one core with one BLAS thread, no warm-up, a cap of 1,800 s per fit, past which a fit is a timeout and never scored; the authors' code's fits that passed it (three, with 200 binary variables) were rerun with a cap of 3,600 s, and eight of its fits that failed to start were rerun. Fisher's z on linear-Gaussian data and the G-square test on binary data at alpha 0.05, the paper's, on both arms; the authors' code with PYTHONHASHSEED=0, since its graph depends on the string hash seed
seeds_note: every cell holds 20 datasets, seeds 0-19; no cell was worse on a measure, and the cells with 200 variables, whose verdict or set floor failed on seeds 0-19, also hold 20 fresh datasets, seeds 20-39 (replication)
cells_note: locpc-<identifiable|nonidentifiable>@5000,v=<d>[,family=binary]: the paper's Erdos-Renyi DAGs with edge probability 2 / (d - 1) and a pair X -> Y whose controlled direct effect is identifiable, or not, in the true CPDAG; linear Gaussian, or the paper's logistic binary model; 5,000 rows; the columns in an order drawn from the seed
pooled_verdict_floor_note: per family and size, seed s pairs the identifiable and the non-identifiable dataset: the mean of their two verdict errors minus 0.5, the error of the constant 'not identifiable' answer over the pair; a row passes when the interval lies wholly below 0. Each arm's row also holds its mean verdict error and its median tests and seconds over the 40 fits, the release card's accuracy against cost
pareto_note: pareto: LocPC-CDE against global PC read at the pair (andrey.pc.adjustment) with the same test and level, accuracy against cost: PC minus Andrey on the verdict error and, on identifiable pairs, the parents error (better when PC's interval lies wholly below 0), and the median tests and seconds per fit. PC counts every query its tests evaluated, Andrey the tests it evaluated (a cached repeat is not a new test), the authors' code every test it ran. PC is better on both only when it is better on accuracy, worse on neither measure, and cheaper in tests and seconds
replication_note: the cells with 200 variables, whose verdict floor or set floor failed on seeds 0-19, rerun on seeds 20-39 with every arm
